g.text: 1. Passes shown schematically (convection + radiant in series per pass); 8 identical passes.
2. Tube-skin thermocouples: 4 per pass (TI-1101..1132) - shown on heater vendor P&ID, alarmed in DCS.
3. Pass flow SIS transmitters FT-10xxA/B/C (2oo3 per pass) independent from BPCS FT-10xx (SIF-101).
4. Decoking (steam-air) connections and spool pieces at inlet / outlet manifolds by heater vendor.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
60.7 MW abs. / 67.4 MW fired; 2-cell cabin, 8 passes, 144 rad. tubes 6"
MAT'L Tubes A335 P9 (9Cr-1Mo); convection P5 / CS studded
